title: RecipeExtraction
description: Minimal extraction target for a recipe document. Every field is wrapped as an object carrying its extracted 'value' alongside a 'confidence' score, used to route low-confidence extractions to human review; array fields score each entry individually. All values use null for facts that are absent from the source document. Demonstrates an enum with a 'value'/'detail' + free-text pattern for category and dietary_flags. This is the schema handed to Claude as the structured-output target, so it is restricted to keywords Claude's json_schema output format supports; the 'other'/detail linkage below is guided only by description text here. See recipe-extraction.validation.schema.json for the full schema that enforces that linkage structurally.

value.description: Required. The name of the recipe as stated in the source document.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that 'value' is correct, from 0.0 (a guess, not supported by the source) to 1.0 (explicitly and unambiguously stated in the source document). Must be consistent with the justification above.

title.description: Required. The recipe's title, with confidence.

value.description: One ingredient line as stated in the source document.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that this ingredient line is correctly and completely extracted from the source, from 0.0 (a guess) to 1.0 (explicitly and unambiguously stated). Must be consistent with the justification above.

ingredients.description: Required. The list of ingredient lines as stated in the source document, each with its own confidence.

value.description: One preparation instruction, in the order it should be performed.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that this is a genuine preparation instruction, correctly extracted from the source (e.g. not a closing pleasantry), from 0.0 (a guess) to 1.0 (explicitly and unambiguously stated). Must be consistent with the justification above.

steps.description: Required. The preparation steps as stated in the source document, one instruction per entry, in the order they should be performed, each with its own confidence.

value.description: Required. The best-fitting category for the recipe. Use 'other' when none of the fixed values fit, and describe it in detail.

detail.description: Free-text category label from the source document, e.g. a German category string that doesn't map to the fixed enum. Must be non-null when value is 'other', and must be null for every other value.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that this category assignment is correct, from 0.0 (a guess) to 1.0 (explicitly stated or an unambiguous fit). Must be consistent with the justification above.

category.description: Required. The recipe's category, with confidence.

value.description: Number of servings/portions the recipe yields. Null if not stated in the source document.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that 'value' is correct, from 0.0 (a guess, not supported by the source) to 1.0 (explicitly and unambiguously stated). A null value should score high when the source clearly omits a serving count, and lower when it's unclear whether it's truly absent. Must be consistent with the justification above.

servings.description: Required, value nullable. Number of servings/portions, with confidence.

value.description: Total preparation time in minutes. Null if not stated in the source document.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that 'value' is correct, from 0.0 (a guess, not supported by the source) to 1.0 (explicitly and unambiguously stated). A null value should score high when the source clearly omits a prep time, and lower when it's unclear whether it's truly absent. Must be consistent with the justification above.

prep_time_minutes.description: Required, value nullable. Total preparation time in minutes, with confidence.

value.description: Calories per serving in kcal. Null if not stated in the source document.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that 'value' is correct, from 0.0 (a guess, not supported by the source) to 1.0 (explicitly and unambiguously stated). A null value should score high when the source clearly omits calories, and lower when it's unclear whether it's truly absent. Must be consistent with the justification above.

calories_kcal.description: Required, value nullable. Calories per serving in kcal, with confidence.

value.description: Calculated from the ingredients. Use 'other' when a diet, restriction, or trend is explicitly mentioned in the source document but isn't one of the other enum values.

detail.description: Free-text description for this entry, e.g. a flag string that doesn't map to the fixed values. Must be non-null when value is 'other', and must be null otherwise.

justification.description: Brief (one sentence) explanation of the evidence for or against this value, or the inference being made.

score.description: Confidence that this specific dietary flag genuinely applies, from 0.0 (a guess) to 1.0 (explicitly stated or an unambiguous inference from the ingredients). Must be consistent with the justification above.

dietary_flags.description: Required, may be empty. Dietary/allergen flags that logically apply to the recipe based on its ingredients, whether or not explicitly stated in the source document. 'vegan' and 'vegetarian' should each appear at most once, with detail null. Add one entry with value 'other' for each distinct applicable flag that doesn't map to the fixed values (e.g. 'gluten-free' and 'nut-free' would be two separate 'other' entries), each with its own detail and confidence.

justification.description: Brief explanation of your holistic judgment - e.g. overall document clarity, how many fields required inference.

score.description: Required. Your own holistic judgment of confidence in the extraction as a whole, from 0.0 to 1.0. Form this independently - do not just average or copy the per-field confidence scores above; weigh things like overall document clarity and how many fields required inference rather than being explicitly stated. Must be consistent with the justification above.

overall_confidence.description: Required. Overall confidence in the entire extraction, independent of the per-field scores.
